summary: Recommended RPM security variables: `postgres_use_ssl: true` (default false) for TLS to the installer-managed database; `pg_sslmode`, `automation_gateway_pg_sslmode`, `automationhub_pg_sslmode`, `automationcontroller_pg_sslmode` set to `verify-full` to enforce mTLS (needs `postgres_use_ssl`); and `nginx_disable_hsts` and the per-component `*_disable_hsts` left `false`.
questions: How do I enable SSL for PostgreSQL in an RPM AAP install?
How do I enforce mTLS between AAP and the database?

answer_card.title: RPM security inventory variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
postgres_use_ssl=true
pg_sslmode=verify-full
automation_gateway_pg_sslmode=verify-full
automationhub_pg_sslmode=verify-full
automationcontroller_pg_sslmode=verify-full
# leave HSTS on (default)
nginx_disable_hsts=false
```
`verify-full` only works with `postgres_use_ssl=true`. A third-party database must be set up for mTLS separately.
